summary: Alcoa filed an 8-K furnishing a preliminary offering memorandum and press release for a $2.6 billion senior notes offering through wholly-owned subsidiaries Alumina Pty Ltd and Alcoa Nederland Holding B.V. Notes comprise 2034 and 2036 maturities. Proceeds, plus cash on hand, fund the roughly $3.1 billion cash portion of Alcoa's previously announced acquisition of South32 Limited's interests in certain bauxite, alumina and aluminum smelter operations (AliGroup) under an Umbrella Implementation Deed dated June 30, 2026. The offering provides permanent financing, expected to terminate the 364-day bridge facility. Closing conditions include South32 shareholder approval, regulatory clearances and customary terms. Watch South32 shareholder vote timing, regulatory approvals and Alcoa's leverage trajectory.
